answer_1.quote: We collectively advance definition generation in the biomedical domain through introducing a terminology definition dataset Graphine and a novel graph-aware text generation model Graphex.

answer_2.quote: For automatic evaluation, we used six standard metrics including BLEU1-4, METEOR and NIST.

answer_4.quote: For human evaluation, we recruited 3 annotators to score the generated sentences of each method for 50 terminologies.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are requested to grade each generated definition as 0 (bad), 1 (fair) and 2 (good).
